content: Qeesetanne Leweta Gakkiza Gisha
Lewetappe qeesetinne qasseka kumeththa Lewe qommoti hankko attida Isra7eele asaara biitta gishettiza wogay isttas baynda gishshas istti GODAAS yarshanaas shiishshiza yarshofe miidi detto.
Istta ishata Isra7eele asaa garsan isttas xinxxo gadey dooppo; izi isttas immida hidota qaala mala GODAY isttas xinxxo.
Wofano gidiin woykko dorsa yarshos shiishshiza wode qeeseti missata, banqilatanne ganjjeta ekketto.
Intte kaththafe xeera, woyne ushshafenne wogara zayteppe xeera, dorsa iskefe koyro qanxxettidayssa isttas immite.
Mernaas qeeseteththan ooththana mala hara qommota giddofe GODAA intte Xoossay Lewe qommota baas doorides.
Lewe qommotappe issi asi kase ba diza Isra7eele katamappe GODAY dooridaso baanaas daro amoy izas diikko,
biidi heen kase haggaziza Lewe qommoti ooththizayssaththo izikka GODAA sinththan ooththo.
Qasse ba aawa aqo bayziin bana gakkidayssa ekkidaa gidikkoka qeeseti go7ettizayssa ubbaa isttara gina gishetti ekko.
Ayzaabeta Wogappe Naagettana Mala Imettida Seera
GODAA intte Xoossay inttes immiza biittaa intte geliza wode he biittan diza kawoteththay ooththiza tuna ooso ooththofte.
Ba attuma naa woykko macca naa yarshos giidi taman xuuggiza ay asikka intte giddon dooppo; bitizay, marace xeellizay, muurennizaynne maroy intte giddon dooppo.
Qasseka daggamizaadey (gojizay), woykko moytille xeygizaadey woykko iita ayanatara haasayzaadey, woykko hayqqida asata ayanara haasayzaadey intte giddon dooppo.
Hessantta mala ooththiza ay asikka GODAA matan ixettidaade; istti hessa mala tuna ooththida gishshas GODAA intte Xoossay he kawoteththata intte sinththafe dhoqalli dhayssana.
GODAA intte Xoossaa sinththan mulera intte ammanettizayta gidanaas bessees.
Muse Mala Sinththafe Dendana Nabe
Ha intte laattanaas biza biittaan diza kawoteththati muurennizaytinne marace xeellizayti yootizayssa siyizayta. Intte gidikko hessaththo ooththontta mala GODAA intte Xoossay inttena diggides.
GODAA intte Xoossay intte zareppe ta mala nabe denththana; intte izi inttes yootizayssa siyidi azazettite.
Intte Siina zuma bolla shiiqida wode GODAA intte Xoossaa, «Nuni hayqqontta mala GODAA nu Xoossaa cenggurssaa zaari siyokko; qasseka ha wolqqama tamaakka nam7anththo be7okko» giidi oychchideta.
Hessa gishshas GODAY taas, «Istti oychchiza oyshay likke» gides.
Tani istta zareta giddofe isttas ne mala nabe denththana; izi haasayana qaala ta izas immana; ta azazizayssa ubbaa izi inttes yootana.
Ta sunththan yootiza he nabeza qaala siyontta as ta qaxxayana.
Gido attiin ta iza azazontta xalateththan ta sunththan yootiza nabey woykko eeqa xoossata sunththan yootiza nabey hayqqo.
Intte, «Nabey yootiza tinbite qaalay GODAAPPE gidonttayssa ta aazan shaakka eranee?» gi oychchana dandayeeta.
He nabezi yootiday GODAA sunththan yootiin izi yootida qaalay polettontta aggiko hessi GODAY yootonttayssa gididayssa ereeta; he nabezi wordo haasayda gishshas izas yayyofte.
